title: Practice 3: Антон Чехов · Анна на шее

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (держать / держаться) он солидно, движения у него были не быстрые, манеры мягкие.
exercises.why: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs. The suffix "-ся" with these verbs indicates action of two or more actors upon one another … Verbs which never occur without the ending "-ся".» — DLI, Lesson 67. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «We already know that the verbs in "-ся" may be divided into several groups … Reflexive verbs. These verbs express an action which is directed back upon the agent or subject … Reciprocal verbs.…

exercises.q: А Аня слушала его, боялась и не могла есть, и обыкновенно ___ (вставать / ложиться / садиться) из-за стола голодной.
exercises.why: «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «Phrases meaning direction are used to denote the place where something is put ("на" + Acc., "в" + Acc., etc.)» «Literally садиться means "to seat oneself". It implies movement to a "seat" and, therefore, answers the question "куда?"» — DLI, Lessons 42, 68.

exercises.why: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension. — DLI, Lessons 46 and 47.  ·  «Больной, раненый and знакомый are often used as adjectival nouns.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending **-ой** if stressed: **новый** — **молодой**; **русский** — **плохой**, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.

exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: Но в ___ (голос) его слышались слабость, доброта, и никто его не боялся.
exercises.why: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The prepositional case is always used with a preposition. With the prepositions в and на it denotes a location … With the preposition о, об this case answers the questions о ком? о чём?» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: А братья Ани, Петя и Андрюша, гимназисты, дергали его сзади за фрак и ___ (шептать / прошептать) сконфуженно:
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: Но вот знакомые дамы засуетились и стали ___ (искать / поискать) для Ани хорошего человека.
exercises.why: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lesson 37.  ·  From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: The imperfective aspect emphasizes the action itself.

exercises.q: ___ (помочь / помогать) нам, — сказала она в нос, нараспев.
exercises.why: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The imperative may be formed from both the imperfective and the perfective verbs.» — DLI, Lesson 42.

exercises.why: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «There is a limited number of adjectives that normally take the short form when used predicatively … The short form of an adjective can never be used as a modifier.» — DLI, Lesson 57.

exercises.q: Теперь остается ожидать ___ (появление) на свет маленького Владимира.
exercises.why: «The person or thing feared is in the Genitive case: Я боюсь этого человека.» «The object (of ждать) is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate.» — DLI, Lessons 27, 66. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The person or thing feared is in the Genitive case: Я боюсь этого человека.» «The object (of ждать) is in the accusative case if animate and in the genitive case if inanimate.» — DLI, Lessons 27, 66.

exercises.q: Она ушла, и Аня заняла ее место около ___ (серебряный) самовара с чашками.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.why: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много, Несколько, Мало, Сколько.» — Wikibooks, «Genitive case». From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «If the number ends in 2, 3 or 4 use the genitive singular … If the number ends in 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 0 or -надцать use the genitive plural.» «There are also other quantity words that take the genitive, either singular or plural according to meaning: Много,…

exercises.q: Когда Аню провожали домой, то уже светало и кухарки шли на ___ (рынок).
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.q: Анюта! — продолжал он, вдруг впадая в ___ (торжественный) тон.
exercises.why: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 46.

exercises.q: Анюта! — продолжал он, вдруг впадая в ___ (торжественный тон).
exercises.why: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "В", "НА", "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Accusative case when they indicate the goal of motion.» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.why: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «Prepositions "ПОД" and "ЗА" are followed by the Instrumental case when they indicate location … Prepositions "НАД", "ПЕРЕД", "МЕЖДУ" and "С".» — DLI, Lesson 61.

exercises.why: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The main functions of the nominative case are: a. The nominative of the subject: Студент читает.» — DLI, Lesson 16.

exercises.q: А братья Ани, Петя и Андрюша, гимназисты, ___ (дёргать) его сзади за фрак и шептали сконфуженно:
exercises.why: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI, Lesson 36. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The past tense is formed by dropping -ть from the infinitive and adding -л for the masculine, -ла for the feminine, -ло for the neuter, -ли for the plural … the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.» — DLI,…

exercises.why: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16. From Антон Чехов, «Анна на шее».
exercises.context: «The following verbs belong to the "Е" type of conjugation: думать, слушать, спрашивать … The verb лежать belongs to the "И" type of conjugation.» — DLI, Lesson 16.
